verdict.rationale: Delegated access is a fair question for a state business-filing agency: who may file or sign on an entity's behalf, filer roles, and agent authorization. Nothing in the pack publishes such rules. The only signature-related item is the Credit Card/Debit Card Authorization Form, which authorizes payment, not a third party acting for the filer, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit. No forms, roles, or personal-signature rules for third-party filers appear anywhere in the evidence.
